interface: detect_components(text, identity) -> deterministic scoped flags; identity source_id/ordinal/text_SHA256/source_JSON_SHA256. Core verifies exact UTF8 text hash; caller independently verifies raw JSON/source-frame ancestry.
output: Each notice and bounded context retains exact character/UTF8 offsets, literal bytes and SHA256. Notice extent is never inferred component-body extent. All matching occurrences retained.
classes: NC/FDL license tokens with local grant-vs-mention cue
explicit generation attribution vs AI-topic, negated/example/conditional language
AI assistance distinct from full authorship
disposition: SCOPED_REVIEW_FLAG_ONLY. No automatic exclusions, admission, grant compatibility, work equivalence, source quota reassignment, or human authorship certification.
failure: Strict UTF8/hash/identity refusal. Any bound exceeded raises without returning partial-success receipt. Future caller must record diagnostic incomplete/resource hold and never silently skip.
limits: Finite literal rules, not exhaustive semantic or licensing analysis. Bare NC/FDL mention is not proof of applicable grant.
Context tags use bounded local heuristics, not legal or linguistic certification; quotations, example and negation may be ambiguous. All flags require scoped source review.
No result flags means UNASSESSED_NOT_CLEARED. No inference that unmarked prose is human or unrestricted.
Exact sourceURL is an ancestry lead, not confirmed same-work family. Wrapper license never overrides captured component terms.
Explicit generation attribution does not prove the attributed component is retained, nor define its extent; proofreading assistance is separate.
No alteration, component stripping, sentence cropping, Unicode/entity normalization or source pass.
